question: In a certain code language, 'HEAT' is written as 'VSGZ' and 'CLAY' is written as 'OXBZ'. How will 'BANK' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here:

**According to the given table, 1st and 2nd letters are interchanged and the letters opposite to them are used in their place, same with 3rd and 4th letter.**

 
• In **HEAT**,

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b178387b4ab79cfa773c586cd3448ba5f6b2d353ac844dd91fbf845319075fb.png] 
 
• So, we get **VSGZ.**
 
 
 
• In **CLAY**,
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8aca7e2c4f6a5e0b199bcf235fb39eae16ca9b75de76beb4b311deea6d46b0dc.png] 
 
• So, we get 'OXBZ'.
 
 
 
• Similarly, in **BANK**,
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eb7bf8a75973a0c2d28c957bb82ed75d4ff29e347df790ef3fe2d680f635775.png] 
 
• So, we get 'ZYPM' .
 
 

​Hence, option 4) is the correct answer.
